entries.title: Enter the Marketplace, if you dare
entries.text: Looking for a scary good time? Explore seven frightfully fun Spooky Spotlight packs! Discover creepy creatures, eerie environments, jarring jump scares, and chilling challenges. What are you waiting for? Enter the Marketplace...if you dare!

entries.title: Avatar Legends add-on
entries.text: Become the Avatar in Minecraft! Discover temples, master the elements, and even unlock the Avatar State. Dress for the occasion with the Blue Spirit mask Character Creator item, available for free in the Marketplace, for a limited time!

entries.title: Minecraft Realms
entries.text: Bring your Wilderness Bound expedition into Minecraft Realms! Gather up to 10 explorers from any Bedrock platform for an expedition through the dappled forest. Subscribe today!

entries.title: Minecraft Dungeons II is live
entries.text: Time to brave the unknown and save the day!

entries.title: New on Java Realms: Grinding & Galaxy
entries.text: 9 maps to entertain you this autumn.

entries.title: Camp Out Challenge
entries.text: Head into the wild to place 200M cushions and 50M straw beds in our community challenge! Place 50% of both to unlock 2 free Character Creator items and a java skin, or place them all before Friday October 2 at 10 AM PT for MORE rewards for all players!

entries.title: Minecraft Live Recap
entries.text: Catch up on the new dimension, Minecraft World, Dungeons II, and more!

entries.title: Play Wilderness Bound
entries.text: Wilderness Bound is out now in Minecraft! Set off into the atmospheric dappled forest, seek out abandoned camps, sleep under the stars, and make the great outdoors your own with new building blocks. Just remember: maps are lighter than regrets!

entries.title: New on Java Realms: Mischiefs & Secrets
entries.text: 9 new and exciting maps have been released this month!

entries.title: The Hero Cape
entries.text: Show off your bravery with the Hero Cape! Play Minecraft Dungeons I and II to get the cape in Dungeons II and in Minecraft: Java & Bedrock Edition. Make sure you use the same Microsoft account across all the games, whether you play solo on your own device or join a friend’s couch co-op session!*

entries.title: Brave a new dimension in Dungeons II
entries.text: Journey into the Sift to explore uncharted lands and fight unfamiliar threats that will test you like never before. Uncover new ways to customize your gear and prepare for the toughest battle yet. Are you ready to face what awaits beyond the rifts?

entries.title: TRANSFORMERS add-on
entries.text: Roll out with the TRANSFORMERS add-on! Morph into your favorite Autobot or Decepticon and explore your world in a whole new way. Take on players in epic, fast-paced battles, like Deathmatch. Customize your look with a free Character Creator item!

entries.title: Pre-order and get 3 exclusive items
entries.text: Pre-order Minecraft Dungeons II today and get 2 hero skins, the Twisted cape, and the Twisted chicken pet.

entries.title: Treasure Hunt
entries.text: Dig deep into Treasure Hunt, a multiplayer mining adventure! Gather and sell resources in ever-evolving worlds and compete against up to 20 players at a time. Build your streak, conquer challenges, and you could land on the real-time leaderboard.

entries.title: Sulfur Cube Marketplace Spotlight
entries.text: Sulfur cubes have sparked a wave of creativity across Minecraft! Explore seven new packs that utilize sulfur cubes’ unique physics to race, golf, solve puzzles, perform trick shots, and more. Find your new favorite way to play in the Marketplace.

entries.title: Dimension Clash
entries.text: Pick your side in Dimension Clash, a fast-paced multiplayer adventure. The Overworld, Nether, and End have collided. Now three teams battle across floating islands in the sky. Spend ESSENCEs for strength, steal your rivals', and claim victory!

entries.title: Marketplace Content: August 2026
entries.text: RLCraft, Huggy & Friends, Excalibur, and so much more

entries.title: OneBlock Online
entries.text: One block, endless possibilities! OneBlock Online is a multiplayer adventure where you grow an entire floating island from a single regenerating block. Unlock new biomes, trade with friends, and earn rewards – one block at a time.

entries.title: Are you ready for 9 new fun maps on Realms?!
entries.text: Are you ready for 9 new fun maps on Realms?!

entries.title: Hello Kitty® and Friends Furniture add-on
entries.text: Make your world cuter with the Hello Kitty® and Friends Furniture add-on! Craft a Vending Machine, collect Gems, and unlock adorable furniture inspired by your favorite characters. Visit the Marketplace to claim your free Keroppi™ Outfit.

entries.title: Chaos Cubed: Pixel Party add-on
entries.text: Chaos Cubed: Pixel Party add-on brings you arcade favorites in the Minecraft style you love for free! Journey through sulfur caves to discover machines, play mini-games, and earn tokens. Bring the fun to your base by collecting all five games.

entries.title: The Aether awaits
entries.text: What if there was a dimension opposite the Nether? Now there is! Step through a glowstone portal with Aether Legends, based on the beloved Java mod. Tame moas, fight Valkyries, and explore a whole new dimension. Ready to explore the sky?

entries.title: Vote for the Winner of the Minecraft Movie
entries.text:
Which build should win the Minecraft Movie Build Challenge?
Cast your vote by July 6 at 11:59PM PT – learn how at aka.ms/votingevent. May the craftiest build win!

entries.title: Marketplace Summer Sale 2026
entries.text: Enjoy hot days and hotter deals during the Marketplace Summer Sale! From June 30 at 10 a.m. PT to July 28 at 10 a.m. PT, get up to 33% off over 300 select sale items, like RealismCraft, Huggy & Friends, and Biomes O’Plenty. Also check out the daily doorbusters, running from June 30 to July 14.

entries.title: Chaos Sparks Challenge
entries.text: Join your chaos team and work together to either place 20 million sulfur blocks, spawn 50 million sulfur cubes, or feed TNT to 10 million sulfur cubes. Triumph before Wed June 24, 10 AM PT and all Bedrock players will get a free Blockception add-on!*

entries.title: Herschel Backpack Trials add-on
entries.text: Expand your inventory and broaden your horizons with the free Herschel Backpack Trials add-on at Minecraft Marketplace. More resources, more gear, and more adventures!

entries.title: More players? More chaos!
entries.text: Put the chaos in Chaos Cubed with Minecraft Realms! Up to 10 friends from any Bedrock platform can join you in wreaking havoc in a private world. Amp it up a notch and subscribe to Realms Plus or Marketplace Pass for curated content!

entries.title: Play Chaos Cubed
entries.text: Chaos Cubed has arrived! Explore a striking cave biome, build with colorful blocks, and unleash the sulfur cube’s weird, block-powered chaos in Minecraft. Play today!

entries.title: Minecraft Dungeons II gameplay reveal & date
entries.text: Watch the trailer and brave the unknown on September 29!

entries.title: Prepare for battle
entries.text: Drop into GenWars, Minecraft's competitive, action-packed multiplayer adventure. Squad up to claim towers, utilize generators, and raid rival bases before time runs out. Think fast, steal loot, and fight your way to the top!

entries.title: Minecraft Movie Build Challenge
entries.text:
Enter the Minecraft Movie Build Challenge for a chance to see your creation in the movie or end credits!* 
Get the free challenge map from Minecraft Marketplace and show off your craft. You can also win a private screening and movie tickets!*

entries.title: Speedrun with Tubbo
entries.text: TwitchCon is here, and Tubbo has teamed up with MCSR Ranked to create two new speedrunning worlds. New to the scene? Start with the free Speedrun Practice World. Ready for more? Get Speedrun World to race against your personal best and earn trophies for milestones!

entries.title: The Tiny Takeover Challenge continues
entries.text: Take on the final community challenge in the Tiny Takeover drop! The land babies came out as victors in the first challenge, but it’s not too late for water babies to get revenge! This time, work together to feed as many golden dandelions as possible to the baby mobs of your team between Apr 3, 8 AM PT to Apr 6, 10 AM PT. After that, both Java and Bedrock players earn adorable in-game outfits!

entries.title: Marketplace Spring Sale
entries.text: Spring means longer days and bigger savings at Minecraft Marketplace! From March 31 at 10 a.m. PT to April 6 at 10 a.m. PT, you can get up to 33% off select Character Creator items and 75% off select Marketplace packs, like seasons and furniture add-ons. New deals go on sale daily, so hop on by!

entries.title: Back your favorite baby mob!
entries.text: Take on the first of two challenges in the Tiny Takeover drop and earn adorable rewards together! Choose a side: land or water! Then name as many baby mobs you can on land OR in water using name tags between Mar 27, 8 AM PT to Mar 30, 10 AM PT!

entries.title: Play Tiny Takeover
entries.text: Tiny Takeover has officially stormed Minecraft! New versions of baby mobs are causing cuteness overload across biomes and builds. Pack your golden dandelions, craft name tags, and get ready to collect, cuddle, and coo over our new tiny rascals.

entries.text: The next chapter of Minecraft Dungeons begins in the fall of 2026! A new threat stirs, ready to descend upon the land and its inhabitants to cause unspeakable mayhem. Become a hero and take on foes unlike anything you’ve faced before, journey through long‑forgotten locations, and clash with the forces of evil once more!
